## Codex adaptation and boundary

Use this only for an explicit request to mine prior chats or for an operator-enabled, trusted project hook. The pinned `agents-memory-updater` is bundled as [a native role reference](references/agents-memory-updater.md). Delegate the full transcript/index/AGENTS.md flow to that bounded role, using the operator-selected model and reasoning effort. Give it only verified transcripts from the current workspace and task. The parent returns the result and does not mine or edit. If no native delegate or verified transcript source is available, report not-run and make no write. The isolated adapter in `scripts/cursor_native_hook_adapters.py` proves only threshold decisions on synthetic Codex Stop payloads; no hook is registered or trusted, and one bounded updater run on a synthetic transcript updated a fixture AGENTS.md and index, but real transcript scope and live host invocation remain unproven. This candidate remains unindexed.
